label: Perdew-Zunger (LDA)
note: QE's LDA short name is sla+pz, i.e. Perdew-Zunger; PSlibrary's pz set writes dft='LDA' and pseudoforge matches it so the decks stay identical.

label: Vosko-Wilk-Nusair (LDA)
note: PHYSICS CHANGE 2026-09-28: was 'VWN'. QE 7.x has no short name VWN (qe_dft_list.f90 defines PZ, PW, VWN-RPA), so 'VWN' was parsed token by token as correlation only; ld1.x wrote 'NOX VWN NOGX NOGC' -- no exchange -- into every file. 'SLA VWN' is Slater exchange with VWN correlation, the LDA this entry names.

label: Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof
note: The default and by far the best tested choice.

label: TPSS
note: ld1.x has no meta-GGA generator; PBE is the accepted generator functional.

label: revTPSS
note: Not a QE short name of its own; generate with PBE.

label: SCAN
note: SCAN calculations are routinely run with PBE-generated pseudopotentials.

label: r2SCAN
note: As SCAN; r2SCAN is the numerically better behaved variant.

label: PBE0
note: ld1.x cannot generate hybrids; hybrid runs use the PBE pseudopotential.

label: B3LYP
note: BLYP is the semilocal parent of B3LYP.

label: vdW-DF (Dion et al.)
note: The nonlocal correlation kernel is absent from ld1.x; revPBE is vdW-DF's exchange.

label: vdW-DF2
note: rPW86 exchange is not available standalone in ld1.x.

label: vdW-DF-cx
note: LV-PW86r exchange is not available standalone in ld1.x.

label: optB88-vdW
note: optB88 exchange is available in ld1.x and is the right semilocal parent.
